definitions.explanation: A document certifying that someone has passed an examination, inspection, or qualification test.

examples.japanese: {合格証|ごうかくしょう}が{届|とど}いた。
{試験|しけん}に{受|う}かって{合格証|ごうかくしょう}をもらった。
examples.english: I passed the exam and received a certificate.

examples.japanese: {合格証|ごうかくしょう}の{再発行|さいはっこう}には{手数料|てすうりょう}がかかります。
examples.english: There is a fee for reissuing the passing certificate.

notes:
A {合格証|ごうかくしょう} is an official certificate proving that someone has successfully passed an examination or met a standard. It is commonly issued for qualification exams such as {漢字検定|かんじけんてい} or {日本語能力試験|にほんごのうりょくしけん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合格証書|ごうかくしょうしょ} — formal certificate of passing (longer, more official form)
- {合格証明書|ごうかくしょうめいしょ} — certificate proving one has passed
- {合格証|ごうかくしょう}を{提示|ていじ}する — to present a passing certificate
- {合格証|ごうかくしょう}を{紛失|ふんしつ}する — to lose a passing certificate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {修了証|しゅうりょうしょう} — certificate of completion (for finishing a course, not necessarily passing an exam)
- {免許証|めんきょしょう} — license (authorizes the holder to do something, such as drive)
- {資格証|しかくしょう} — qualification certificate
